configurations.name: dev
runtimeArgs: NODE22="$(ls -d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/v22.*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"; [ -n "$NODE22" ] && export PATH="$NODE22:$PATH"; node --version; [ -d node_modules ] || corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; [ -f packages/config/dist/index.js ] && [ -f packages/sdk/dist/index.js ] || corepack pnpm --filter @raffle-fun/config --filter @raffle-fun/sdk build; exec corepack pnpm run dev
